newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPG activity slow ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPG activity slow ahead of weekend.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were steady to weaker in quiet activity on Friday ahead of the weekend.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane held at 33.75/34.00 cents a gallon in quiet trade. Conway, Kansas, material also held at 35.00/35.50 cents.
The butane market in Conway was down slightly, with normal butane trading at 37.27/37.50 cents. Natural gasoline traded at 42.75/43.00 cents.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
